slices.title: Request a reset link

slices.title: Expire reset links
slices.value: An old reset email cannot be used to take over an account
scope: Reject tokens older than the configured expiry; when the expiry setting is unset, fall back to 60 minutes

Add an expiry setting to config/auth.ts and config/defaults.ts, read it in the token checker, the reset page loader, the email template renderer, the audit logger, and the admin settings page, and document it

criteria.text: A 61-minute-old link is rejected with a clear message
With the setting unset, links expire after 60 minutes
The expired-link page offers a new link
Expired attempts are logged; the log line has the account id
